title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement: Given a string s, return the length of the longest contiguous substring that contains no repeated characters.
hints: Grow a window over the string and shrink it from the left whenever a duplicate character appears.
Track the last index at which each character was seen so you know exactly how far to move the left edge.
For each right pointer, if s[right] was last seen at or after left, set left = last_seen[s[right]] + 1; then update last_seen and the best length as right - left + 1.
